audit.whatIsWrong: Mordekaiser's Q is called 'Mace of Spades' in five places — spikes[0].text, wants.you[0], wants.foe[0], content.early and whys[1]. Its name is Obliterate. Mace of Spades was the pre-rework ability and has not existed for years.
audit.why: Same failure mode as 'Ares of Blaze' for Pyroclasm: a player who reads the page and then looks at Mordekaiser's bar finds nothing called Mace of Spades, and the credibility of the surrounding advice goes with it.
audit.corrected: Obliterate used in all five places.

audit.whatIsWrong: Obliterate costs 0 mana and runs on 8/7/6/5/4s. Neither fact appears anywhere.
audit.why: It is why the early lane is unwinnable rather than merely bad: Kassadin is rationing a 60-to-80 mana Null Sphere against an opponent who can throw his main damage spell at the wave and at Kassadin indefinitely for nothing. The page tells him to 'farm at range' without explaining that he cannot out-attrit a free ability.
audit.corrected: Stated in phases[1].why, spikes[0].text, content.early and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early says Indestructible 'heals a portion of the damage he deals and takes'. Riot's text is that it STORES damage dealt and taken to create a shield, which he may then consume to heal — two steps, on a 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown.
audit.why: The distinction is the counterplay. The shield exists whether or not he cashes it, so poke does not merely fail to stick — it is actively converted into his defensive layer, and the anti-heal the itemization block recommends only bites on the second step.
audit.corrected: Corrected in tradeBad, breakdown.early, content.early, whys[2] and the itemization note.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0] to [4] are the generic Kassadin boilerplate — 'your worst level in the game', 'the survival grind' — and none of them names an ability or a number. phases[0] also calls level 1 his worst while content whys[0] calls the same level a coin-flip.
audit.why: Level 1 against Mordekaiser is genuinely neutral — he has one auto-attack and no Obliterate. The real cliff is level 2-3 when the E-pull-into-isolated-Q combo comes online, and the chart gives that stage the same flat description as every other.
audit.corrected: phases[0] through [4] rewritten around Obliterate's free 8s cast, Death's Grasp's 700-range pull at 16s, and Realm of Death.

audit.whatIsWrong: full.diff reads HARD but diffRating is 5.5/10 and both rating lines say 'Even matchup', on a lane recorded at 40.91% over 22 games.
audit.why: Three fields, two verdicts, and the numeric one is the optimistic outlier.
audit.corrected: diffRating 5.5/10 to 6.5/10 and both lines reworded to 'Hard matchup', matching diff=HARD and the win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns says 'track it always' and 'read it like a second minimap' without a single number.
audit.why: Realm of Death is 140/120/100s — the longest cooldown in the lane and the only one worth building a plan around. Obliterate is 8s to 4, Death's Grasp 16s to 8.
audit.corrected: All three written in, plus dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, tradeGood, phases[3].why and All-In Windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Void Stone appears as '15% magic reduction' in spikes[1].text and content.mid, and phases[2].why carries the 'E only charges when spells fly' boilerplate.
audit.why: Void Stone has been 10% since V11.24; Force Pulse stopped being charge-gated in V12.23 and is now a 21/20/19/18/17s cooldown shortened by a second per nearby ability cast. The kit file still reproduces Riot's pre-rework tooltip, which is how both errors survive.
audit.corrected: 15% set to 10% in both places; phases[2].why rewritten to the cooldown model.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.late instructs the player to 'Q-silence the counterplay', and tradeGood/dosFull/dontsFull repeat 'repeat every six seconds'.
audit.why: Null Sphere has no silence, and nothing in Kassadin's kit runs on six seconds — Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s and Null Sphere 9 down to 7.
audit.corrected: Silence replaced with the shield; the six-second cadence replaced with Obliterate's real 8s clock.

edits.before: Morde gets Death's Grasp (E) and Mace of Spades (Q) online — his E pull lands a single-target Q for the isolated bonus damage, two-shotting your tiny mana pool before you have Riftwalk to leave.
edits.after: Morde gets Death's Grasp (E) and Obliterate (Q) online — the E pull sets up a single-target Obliterate for its isolated bonus damage, and that Q costs him no mana on an 8s clock.

edits.before: Realm of Death (R) banishes you into a 1v1 pocket and steals a chunk of your AP for its duration — Void Stone's 15% magic reduction and Null Sphere's shield barely dent it, so never be caught low when his ult is up.
edits.after: Realm of Death (R) banishes you into a 1v1 pocket on a 140s clock and steals a chunk of your AP for its duration — Void Stone's 10% magic reduction and Null Sphere's shield barely dent it, so never be caught low while it is up.

edits.before: Catalyst/Rod of Ages finally lets you survive longer, but his Riftmaker or Liandry's out-DPSes your stall and his Indestructible (W) heals the poke back — keep farming, do not try to duel.
edits.after: Catalyst/Rod of Ages finally lets you survive longer, but his Riftmaker or Liandry's out-DPSes your stall and Indestructible (W) banks your poke as his shield every 12s — keep farming, do not duel.

edits.after: Dodge Death's Grasp (E) so he can't drag you in for an isolated Obliterate (Q) hit

edits.before: Land Death's Grasp (E) to pull you in for a single-target Mace of Spades (Q) at full isolated bonus damage
edits.after: Land Death's Grasp (E) to pull you in for a single-target Obliterate (Q) at full isolated bonus damage

edits.before: Level 1 you are helpless — Null Sphere is all you have, no escape, and Morde just walks up. The whole problem is his E, Death's Grasp: if he pulls you in, his Q (Mace of Spades) lands as a single-target hit for its isolated bonus damage and your shallow mana pool can't trade back. Hug the wave, last-hit with Q range, and never stand where one E can drag you under his tower. His Indestructible (W) heals a portion of the damage he deals and takes, so chipping him with Q just feeds his shield — don't waste mana on it.
edits.after: Level 1 you are helpless — Null Sphere is all you have, no escape, and Morde just walks up. The whole problem is his E, Death's Grasp: pull you in and Obliterate lands as a single-target hit for its isolated bonus, and that Q costs him zero mana on an 8-second clock while your pool is shallow. Hug the wave, last-hit at Q range, and never stand where one E can drag you under tower. Indestructible banks the damage he deals AND takes as a shield he can cash for health, so chipping him just funds it.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still pure survival — Nether Blade (W) restoring mana on-hit lets you farm under tower, but you cannot duel a Morde whose Indestructible out-sustains your poke. At 6 his Realm of Death is the real danger: he can banish you into a 1v1 box and even with Void Stone's 15% magic reduction and Null Sphere's shield, his stat-steal flips the duel and walks away with your AP. Hold Riftwalk to dodge the E pull and reposition inside the death realm, never to fight him head-on.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are still pure survival — Nether Blade (W) restoring mana on-hit lets you farm under tower, but you cannot duel a Morde whose Indestructible out-sustains your poke. At 6 his Realm of Death is the real danger: he can banish you into a 1v1 box and even with Void Stone's 10% magic reduction and Null Sphere's shield, his stat-steal flips the duel and walks away with your AP. Hold Riftwalk to dodge the E pull and reposition inside the death realm, never to fight him head-on.

notes: THE HEADLINE IS THE ABILITY NAME: Mordekaiser's Q is Obliterate. The page called it 'Mace of Spades' in five separate strings — the pre-rework name, dead for years. This is the same class of error as 'Ares of Blaze' for Pyroclasm in the calibration list, and it is worth grepping the whole champ-data set for, because a name that stale usually came from a shared template rather than this one page. BLOCKED BY THE LENGTH BAND: content win[] reads Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Skill/Kassadin/Kassadin while the packet's levelChart reads Skill/Mordekaiser x5/Kassadin — they disagree at level 1, level 6 and first item, and the page hands Kassadin a first-item lead on a lane he wins 40.91% of. 'Mordekaiser' is 11 characters against 'Kassadin' at 8 (-27%) and 'Skill' at 5 (-55%); every substitution blows the band, so the chart needs a hand fix. Note also that full phases[0].why calls level 1 Kassadin's worst level while content whys[0] calls the same level a coin-flip — I rewrote phases[0].why to agree with whys[0] and with the packet. CHAMPION-WIDE, VERIFIED ON THE WIKI: Void Stone is 10% magic damage reduction, not 15% (V11.24), and Force Pulse has not been charge-gated since V12.23 — the 'E only charges when spells fly' line in phases[2].why is present on all 71 Kassadin matchups and wrong on all of them; the kit file reproduces Riot's stale tooltip, so it will regenerate unless fixed at the source.
